options: A variable that holds multiple values (or records) of the same data type
A variable that can only hold text
A special kind of formula resource
A variable that automatically deletes itself after one use
questions.explain: A collection variable holds multiple values — numbers, text, or full records — as long as they share a data type.

questions.q: What setting on a Get Records element turns its result into a collection instead of a single record?
options: Setting Condition Requirements to All Conditions Are Met
Changing How Many Records to Store from 'Only the first record' to 'All records'
Adding a Sort Order
Renaming the element's API Name
questions.explain: Only the first record stores a single-record variable; All records stores a collection variable instead.

questions.q: After running a Collection Filter element on a collection, what happens to the original collection?
options: It's deleted
It's sorted but not filtered
It's left completely untouched — Collection Filter creates a new, separate collection
It's merged with the filtered result
questions.explain: Collection Filter produces a duplicate, narrowed collection; the original collection variable is unaffected.

questions.q: How does Collection Sort behave differently from Collection Filter?
options: Collection Sort also creates a brand-new collection, just like Collection Filter
Collection Sort modifies the collection you select, in place, rather than creating a new one
Collection Sort can only work on text collections
Collection Sort cannot limit the number of items kept
questions.explain: Unlike Collection Filter, Collection Sort reorders (and optionally truncates) the same collection variable rather than producing a new one.

questions.q: When is it best practice to use Get Records' own filter/sort settings instead of separate Collection Filter and Collection Sort elements?
options: Never — Collection Filter and Sort should always be used instead
When the filter/sort criteria is already known at the time Get Records is configured — it's more efficient
Only when working with text collections
Only inside a Loop element
questions.explain: Get Records' own filtering and sorting is more efficient; Collection Filter/Sort are for criteria that can't be known until later in the flow.
